title: Boost
buttonTitle: Send a boost with a message to the creator
messageHint: Shown with the amount on this post's boost wall.

wall.title: Boosts
wall.empty: No boosts yet. Be the first to boost this post.
wall.failed: The boost wall could not be loaded.
wall.note: Only payments that can be seen on Hive show here: HIVE and HBD, and Lightning through v4v.app.

stream.title: Stream sats
stream.intro: While you listen, send a few sats to the creator every minute, from your Lightning wallet in the browser.
stream.budget: Your wallet asks before each payment unless you give 3Speak a budget in it. Payments stop when you say no, or at your monthly limit.
stream.capped: Your monthly limit is reached. Streaming is paused until next month.
stream.stopped: Streaming stopped: the wallet did not pay.
